title: Water the seedling benches before dawn
body:
# Water the seedling benches before dawn

## Context
Seedlings dry out fast once the glass warms, so the benches are watered while the house is still cool.

## Decision
Every bench runs a 12 minute cycle, one bench at a time. The night grower starts the first bench and logs the start time on the wall sheet.

## Consequences
The pump never serves two benches at once, and the last bench finishes before the first light.

title: Size the irrigation tank for peak benches
body:
# Size the irrigation tank for peak benches

## Context
The tank has to hold what the busiest night draws.

## Decision
Each seedling bench runs a 12 minute cycle. The caretaker tops up the tank from the rain barrel whenever the gauge drops below the red line.

## Consequences
The tank is sized from the bench count, and the barrel is the first source.

title: Log pump pressure after each bench cycle
body:
# Log pump pressure after each bench cycle

Record the pump pressure on the wall sheet when a bench cycle ends, and flag any reading under the pump's rated minimum.
